scope: Ordinary source/AST and saved sanitized evidence only; no imports of target wrappers, execution, process/network/guard/peer actions, private lease reads or Git/index actions. Only this new review record was created.

blockers.finding: The starter retains the actual new lease locally, but passes its private-file path only to the child environment. Its parent failure latch reads AMIGA_LAUNCH_LEASE from the parent environment. A failure after reserve but before/after private-file serialization, preflight save, or successful child return can therefore fail HOLD confirmation or select an inherited lease. The durable reservation remains and grants no new owner; nevertheless the explicit first-failure HOLD contract is not met.
blockers.requiredCorrection: In a distinct packet, latch failure using the actual locally reserved lease after verifying current reservation target/run identity/controller and exact source/candidate binding match. Refuse foreign or uncertain state. Do not rely solely on environment or readable private serialization, and do not print tokens.
blockers.smallestTests: Temporary-root injected/no-target failures immediately after reserve before serialization, during serialization, after serialization/preflight save, and after a synthetic successful lifecycle return; verify own HOLD, retained reservation, zero foreign-state modification and zero target effects.

blockers.finding: Custody hashes the candidate before later byte acquisition. The run then records the staged fingerprint without comparing the actual acquired/staged bytes to immutable binding.candidate. Guest checksums compare with those newly acquired bytes, while settlement/release trust run.candidate. A changed byte stream between custody and acquisition could remain self-consistent through those later records and still be called exact.
blockers.requiredCorrection: In a distinct packet, verify in-memory byte count/hash and staged fingerprint equal the immutable promoted candidate before guest checksum or launch. Reassert run.candidate equals binding.candidate in settlement and release before accepting their proof.
blockers.smallestTests: Host-only injected candidate-byte/stage-fingerprint divergence refuses before dispatch; altered run candidate refuses settlement and release; unchanged exact bytes pass the comparisons. Preserve v2 callers and first evidence.

acceptedPatterns: The transient startup lock probe ends before reserve; reserve atomically refuses an intervening global owner and the actual lifecycle child takes test.lock. Holding the parent lock through that child would conflict.

Grouped read-only IPC metadata calls still use install_ipc operation/transport and exact durable lease/nonce revalidation after awaited connection, immediately before write and before success. Caller admission verifies CPU/FPU/memory/AGA/DMA/paused; live checks owned PID/profile plus connected endpoint before staging and MCP effects. No full-metadata-per-query requirement was found.

Single recorded launch, fixed420-second observable completion bound, exact complete three-line stdout/RC0/COMPLETE, all6-file custody, completed-passing-only settlement, and first-failure no automatic cleanup/retry are explicit.
Settlement imports public emulator.main and invokes exactly [stop,--target,amiberry-030]; underlying wrapper uses profile-checked bounded SIGTERM only.
Independent release verifies process/listener/connection absence and exact custody/pins, binds four records, and closes the transport probe FD before guard.release owns the validated transport lock.
Physical/audio/timing/placement/native UI and measured stack remain explicitly unqualified; selected installed-interface pinning is not full service/package qualification.
